info.title: SAP Document AI ODATA V4 APIs
info.description: SAP Document AI helps you process large numbers of business documents containing a wide variety of content and structures. After you upload a document file to SAP Document AI, it extracts data across different sections and layouts, regardless of how the information is organized within the document.

post.description:
Uploads a file using one of three content types.

You can provide the following parameters: `fileName`, `clientId`, and `ocrEngine`.

**`multipart/form-data`** — Standard multipart upload.
- **File content:** `content` form field (required)
- **`fileName`:** Optional — falls back to the uploaded file's original name. Can be provided via query parameter or header.
- **`clientId`:** Optional. Can be provided via form field, query parameter, or header.
- **`ocrEngine`:** Optional. Can be provided via form field, query parameter, or header.

**`application/json`** — Base64-encoded upload. Unknown fields in the body are rejected.
- **File content:** `file` body field, base64-encoded (required)
- **`fileName`:** Required. Can be provided via JSON body, query parameter, or header.
- **`clientId`:** Optional. Can be provided via JSON body, query parameter, or header.
- **`ocrEngine`:** Optional. Can be provided via JSON body, query parameter, or header.

**`application/octet-stream`** — Raw binary upload. File bytes streamed directly as the request body.
- **File content:** Request body (required)
- **`fileName`:** Required. Can be provided via query parameter (`fileName`) or header (`sap-doc-file-name`).
- **`clientId`:** Optional. Can be provided via query parameter or header.
- **`ocrEngine`:** Optional. Can be provided via query parameter or header.

**Parameter name mapping:**
- Query parameters: `fileName`, `clientId`, `ocrEngine`
- Headers: `sap-doc-file-name`, `sap-doc-client-id`, `sap-doc-ocr-engine`

**Important:** If you provide `fileName`, `clientId`, or `ocrEngine`, all of them must come from the same source. Mixing sources (e.g. `fileName` from query parameter and `clientId` from header) will result in an error.

clientId.description: Optional client identifier (form field). Cannot be combined with the clientId query parameter or sap-doc-client-id header.

ocrEngine.description: Optional OCR engine selector (form field). Allowed values: Document or SceneText. Cannot be combined with the ocrEngine query parameter or sap-doc-ocr-engine header.

fileName.description: File name. Required — must be provided here or via the fileName query parameter or sap-doc-file-name header, but not in combination.

clientId.description: Optional client identifier. Can alternatively be supplied via the clientId query parameter or sap-doc-client-id header — but not in combination.

ocrEngine.description: Optional OCR engine selector. Allowed values: Document or SceneText. Can alternatively be supplied via query parameter or header — but not in combination.

schema.description: Raw binary file content. fileName must be provided via the fileName query parameter or sap-doc-file-name header.

400.description: Validation or business rule errors during file upload. Possible validation and processing errors are documented via the examples below.

error.message: No file provided
File validation failed: File name is not provided
File size exceeds the limit of 25 MB
MalwareException occurred while scanning file: Malware scan request failed with status: 500
MalwareException occurred while scanning file: Malware scan response body is null
MalwareException occurred while scanning file: Malware scan response missing 'malwareDetected' field
MalwareException occurred while scanning file: Malware detected: EICAR-Test-File
MalwareException occurred while scanning file: Malware detected: Unknown threat
Unexpected error during malware scan for file
Invalid file type
File exceeds the limit of 1000 pages
Query condition characters exceeded the limit of 4000
Query condition is empty
Query condition is not provided
Invalid file name. Only Unicode letters, numbers, _, -, . are allowed. File name should not start with special characters.
Document name exceeds maximum length of 255 characters.
Failed to get latest status of file 12345678-1234-1234-1234-123456789012
No content retrieved
Error during retrieval of content from object store: timeout
File ID is not provided
Invalid image data type
Unauthorized: You are not allowed to update this file.
File name is required (provide via query param 'fileName' or header 'sap-doc-file-name').
Unsupported Content-Type. Supported types: multipart/form-data, application/json, application/octet-stream.
Parameters must come from a single source (query params OR headers OR form fields).

post.description: Classifies the type of document based on its content and format.

Extracts structured information from a document based on a user schema. You can optionally include additional instructions to guide the extraction process, such as formatting preferences, extraction rules, or contextual clarifications.
Provides answers to questions based on input userQuery.

Generates a summary (with, for example, ~150 words) by rewriting and condensing the original text in new wording; or generates a summary by selecting and extracting the most important sentences directly from the original text. Set isAbstract to true to get an abstractive summary instead of the default extractive summary.

isSapOnly.description: Indicates whether the model is restricted to SAP-internal use only.

version.description: The version identifier of the model.

retirementDate.description: The date after which this version will no longer be supported. Null if no retirement is planned.

isLatest.description: Indicates whether this is the latest available version of the model.

isForSchemaExtraction.description: Indicates whether this model version supports structured schema-based extraction.
